_meta.note: English source strings. Instrument item text is NOT here: it comes verbatim from the API (validated instrument wording).

common.tagline: Helps people go from a positive check-in to the right care. A fixed safety check runs before any AI.
common.syntheticBanner: Synthetic data only. Not a medical device.
common.sessionExpired: Your demo session has ended. Choose a persona again.

badges.calculatedHint: Output of a fixed, versioned rule
badges.aiHint: Wording drafted by AI and checked against the scores

gates.validatorBlocked: AI text didn't pass our checks, so you're seeing the standard text
gates.clinicianPending: A clinician still needs to confirm this. You can book now.
gates.consentOff: AI summaries are off in your privacy choices

judge.title: Judge Mode
judge.oneLiner: Jisr follows each positive mental-health check-in until the person is seen by the right service. Rules suggest the step, a clinician confirms it, and AI only helps with wording.
judge.passcodeHelp: Given in the submission form. Only unlocks synthetic data.
judge.loginFailed: Couldn't sign in. Check the passcode and make sure the API is running.
judge.resetConfirm: Reset all synthetic demo data to the starting state?
judge.legendTitle: Three kinds of content, shown separately
judge.tour1: Mariam: screen → result → next step → book in three taps.
judge.tour2: Mariam: type an indirect crisis phrase in the free-text box. Watch the gate fire.
judge.tour3: Khalid: the RED episode is pinned on top with a 15-minute clock. Acknowledge it.
judge.tour4: Dr Salma: one-screen summary, confirm the step. AI cannot.
judge.tour5: Programme lead: simulated conversion vs baseline, fairness with suppressed cells.

mariam.name: Mariam
mariam.desc: 34, Emirati, on Thiqa. Prefers Arabic and a female doctor by video. Worried her employer will find out.

imran.name: Imran
imran.desc: 41, on a basic plan, speaks Urdu and English. Already in care, so you can see his progress.

dr_salma.name: Dr Salma
dr_salma.desc: Family physician. Signs off every step change. Has about six minutes per patient.

khalid.name: Khalid
khalid.desc: Looks after the crisis queue and any referral that's running late.

programme_lead.name: Programme lead
programme_lead.desc: Wants to know how many people reach care, how fast, and whether every group is treated fairly. Sees totals only.

person.exitHint: Exit can't erase your browser history. Use a private window for extra privacy.

home.title: A short check-in
home.intro: A few questions about the last two weeks. It takes about three minutes, and your answers help us suggest the right support.
home.notDx: This is not a diagnosis and it is not therapy.
home.privacy: Nothing is shared with your employer.
home.noSession: Choose a person in Judge Mode first.

screen.reassure: Take your time. No right or wrong answers.
screen.arPending: We're still waiting on the validated Arabic wording, so the official English question is shown.
screen.saveFailed: We couldn't save that answer. Please try again.

note.title: Almost done
note.prompt: Is there anything else you'd like us to know? (optional)
note.privacy: Only your care team can read this.
note.label: Anything else you want to tell us

result.title: Your result
result.noteGiven: You also wrote a note. It was checked for safety first.
result.tplMeans: Your answers suggest worry or low mood has been affecting your days more than usual. A lot of people go through this, and support helps.
result.tplDoesnt: It isn't a diagnosis, and it doesn't mean something is wrong with you.
result.tplNext: On the next screen you'll see a kind of support that fits your answers and what you prefer.
result.aiWhy: This summary was written by AI using only your scores, then checked by rules. It can't change your result or your next step.
result.aiLoading: Writing a short summary for you…
result.aiLocked: AI explanations are off while we make sure you're safe.
result.aiUnavailable: The short summary isn't available right now. The standard explanation above says the same thing.
result.belowThreshold: Your answers don't suggest you need extra support right now.
result.loadFailed: We couldn't load your result. Your answers are saved.
result.noResult: No result yet. Start a check-in first.

step.title: Your next step
step.providersTitle: Options that fit you, best match first
step.noCandidates: We haven't found a match yet. You can start with self-guided support while a clinician looks at your step.
step.loadFailed: We couldn't load your next step.
step.redLocked: Someone from the care team is handling this with you directly. If you want to talk now, use the help numbers.

book.title: Confirm and send
book.consentIntro: Each switch works straight away, and you can change it any time.

share_with_receiving_provider.label: Share my referral with the chosen clinician
share_with_receiving_provider.desc: Scores, step and preferences go to the clinician you chose.

share_physical_context.label: Share my physical health check results
share_physical_context.desc: For example HbA1c, BMI and blood pressure from your IFHAS check, so the clinician sees the full picture.

ai_drafted_summaries.label: Allow AI-drafted summaries
ai_drafted_summaries.desc: Lets AI write plain-language text from your scores, without your name. If it's off, you see standard text.

store_free_text.label: Keep what I write in free-text boxes
store_free_text.desc: If it's off, we only keep the result of the safety check, never your words.

notify_sms.label: SMS reminders (discreet wording)
notify_sms.desc: The text won't say what it's about.

notify_whatsapp.label: WhatsApp reminders (discreet wording)
notify_whatsapp.desc: The message won't say what it's about.

book.previewReferral: Your scores, suggested step and preferences
book.previewNothing: Nothing yet. The clinician can only receive the referral if you allow it.
book.employer: Nothing is shared with your employer.
book.insurer: Your insurer only gets what a normal claim for the appointment needs. They never see your answers, scores or notes.
book.consentRequired: Sharing with the clinician is needed to send the request.
book.noProvider: Choose an option on the previous screen first.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.sent: Request sent. Nothing was shared with your employer.
plan.noEpisode: No plan yet. Start a check-in first.

states.DECLINED_BY_PROVIDER: That clinic can't take you, so we're finding another

desc.emergency: If you are in danger now

crisis.alerted: Our care team has been alerted and will try to contact you.
crisis.alertFailed: We couldn't alert the care team. Please call one of the numbers above.
crisis.noSession: Please call one of the numbers above if you need to talk to someone now.
crisis.trust: If you can, stay with someone you trust.
crisis.aiOff: AI explanations are off while we make sure you're safe.
crisis.failClosed: We couldn't check your message, so we're showing you the help numbers to be safe.
crisis.demoNote: Demo: alerts go to Khalid's synthetic queue.

staff.title: Care console
staff.redBanner: {count, plural, one {# RED episode needs acknowledgement} other {# RED episodes need acknowledgement}}
staff.forbidden: This role can't open the care console.

episode.title: Episode summary
episode.physicalNone: Not shared. Either the person hasn't agreed, or no results were imported.
episode.noAi: No AI-drafted content on this screen.

confirm.title: Confirm or change step
confirm.clinicianOnly: Only a clinician can confirm a step.
confirm.stale: Someone else updated this episode. We reloaded it, so please check and confirm again.

simulate.title: Simulate provider (Judge Mode)
simulate.note: Plays the part of the receiving clinic's system.
simulate.noReferral: There's no referral on this episode yet. Book as Mariam first and these buttons will use it.

programme.title: Programme dashboard
programme.aggregate: Aggregate figures only. No individual data is shown.
programme.suppressionNote: Groups with fewer than {k} people are hidden. We hide one more as well, so nobody can work out the hidden number from the totals.
programme.forbidden: This role can't open the programme dashboard.

landing.eyebrow: DoH Abu Dhabi · Future Health Challenge · C10
landing.h1b: to the right care, on time.
landing.sub: Abu Dhabi is screening more people for anxiety and depression every year. Too many of them never make it to a first appointment. Jisr follows each person until they do.
landing.problemTitle: Imagine scoring “moderate” on a screening form, then hearing nothing for three weeks.
landing.problemBody: You don't know where to go, whether your insurance covers it, or whether your manager will find out. So you wait, and it gets worse.
landing.stat1Label: of adults in an Abu Dhabi sample scored moderate to severe on the PHQ-9
landing.stat1Source: Population Medicine, Abu Dhabi population study
landing.stat2Label: family physicians trained in common mental-health conditions
landing.statConvLabel: reach care: today vs with Jisr
landing.statDaysLabel: median days to care: today vs with Jisr
landing.statRecallLabel: of crisis phrases caught, out of {n} test cases (target 100%)
landing.statsUnavailable: Start the demo API to see the simulated figures here.
landing.flowTitle: Five steps, each with an owner and a deadline
landing.flowSub: Every step is recorded, so you can see who did what and when.

screen.title: Screen
screen.body: PHQ-9 and GAD-7, scored with fixed rules.

gate.title: Crisis gate
gate.body: Checks question 9 and the person's own words before any AI runs. Takes under a second.

step.title: Lightest safe step
step.body: Levels L0 to L4, matched on severity, language, clinician gender, insurance and wait time.

handoff.title: Hand-off
handoff.body: A referral the person agreed to, with a named owner and a clock.

outcome.title: Follow-up
outcome.body: Re-checks every two weeks to see if things are actually getting better.

landing.uniqueTitle: Built so safety can't be skipped

gate.title: Safety check before AI
gate.body: Fixed rules read every answer and every message first. AI can flag more risk, but it can never clear it.

trace.title: Every AI sentence has a source
trace.body: Each sentence the AI writes points to the facts it used. If a sentence mentions anything that isn't in those facts, it gets removed.

clinician.title: A clinician signs off
clinician.body: The rules suggest a step. Only a clinician can confirm or change it.

employer.title: Employers can't see anything
employer.body: There's no login for employers, insurers or family admins. The person decides what gets shared.

landing.personasSub: Each card signs you in with made-up data. None of these are real people.
landing.footer: Synthetic data only. Not a medical device. Jisr doesn't diagnose and isn't therapy.
landing.newNote: Safety check tested on 157 phrases in five languages
landing.railsEyebrow: Designed for Abu Dhabi's health system
landing.railsNote: Jisr follows these standards and is shaped to connect to these systems. No live integration in this prototype.
landing.problemBody2: The C10 brief calls this the gap between a positive screen and timely follow-up. Jisr is built for that gap.

tour.title: The 3-minute tour
tour.intro: Six stops. Each button signs you in as the right person and opens the right screen. Come back here between stops.
tour.tip: Tip: reset the demo on the overview first, so every judge sees the same starting point.
tour.failed: Couldn't sign in. Check the passcode on the overview and that the API is running.

s1.title: Screen → result → step → book
s1.body: Answer the check-in with moderate scores. You'll see the explanation, a matched Arabic-speaking female doctor, and you can book in three taps.

s2.title: Companion: the safety check steps in
s2.body: As Imran, type an indirect phrase like the Arabizi "ma abi a3eesh" or the Roman Urdu "jeene ka dil nahi karta". The AI stops and a person takes over.

s3.title: Crisis case on top, 15-minute clock
s3.body: The new crisis case sits at the top of the queue. Acknowledge it.

s4.title: AI hand-off you can check
s4.body: Open a case, draft the hand-off summary, hover the source tags, then confirm the step yourself.

s5.title: Copilot and what-if sliders
s5.body: Ask the Copilot a question, then move the capacity and response-time sliders.

s6.title: Safety benchmark, live
s6.body: Run the safety check against all the test phrases and watch the results come in.

companion.title: Jisr Companion
companion.subtitle: A quiet place to talk things through. It can't diagnose or give therapy, but it can help you find your next step.
companion.placeholder: Type how you're feeling (English, العربية or Arabizi)…
companion.gateIdle: Safety check on. It runs before the AI sees anything.
companion.gateClear: Safety check done in {ms} ms, nothing found
companion.gateHit: AI paused. A person will help.
companion.gateHitBody: It sounds like you might need support right now. We've let the care team know.
companion.lockedNote: The companion stays paused for now. The help numbers are always here.
companion.welcome: Hi. I'm here to listen. What's on your mind today?
companion.ex1: I've been feeling low and tired for weeks
companion.ex2: What kind of support fits me?
companion.failClosed: We couldn't reach the safety check, so we're showing you the help numbers to be safe.
companion.gateClearFast: Safety check done in under 1 ms, nothing found

handoff.title: AI hand-off summary
handoff.factsHint: Each sentence has to point to at least one fact. Hover or tap a tag to see which.
handoff.removedDefault: Removed: it mentions a number, date or name that isn't in its facts
handoff.lockedRed: AI summaries are off while this episode is RED.
handoff.empty: Draft a summary and you'll see which facts each sentence came from.

trajectory.title: Symptom trajectory
trajectory.rciNote: Reliable change = at least {phq} points on PHQ-9 or {gad} on GAD-7 between checks.
trajectory.empty: Your trajectory appears after the first re-check.
trajectory.note: Lower is better. The shaded band is at or above the caseness line.

dash.timeToCareSub: Median days from positive screen to first appointment
dash.whatIfSub: Move a slider and the simulation runs again on the synthetic cohort.
dash.aggregateNote: Totals only. No individual is shown.

copilot.title: Programme Copilot
copilot.sub: Ask a question in plain words. The numbers come from the analytics engine, and the AI only puts them into sentences.
copilot.placeholder: Ask about conversion, fairness, SLAs or regions…
copilot.q1: Which nationality group has the lowest conversion?
copilot.q2: How has median time to care changed over 12 weeks?
copilot.q3: Are we meeting the crisis acknowledgement SLA?

safety.title: Safety benchmark
safety.sub: The fixed safety check, run live on test phrases in Arabic, English, Arabizi and Urdu. No AI involved.
safety.fpNote: A false alarm means someone talks to a person sooner. Missing a real one is what we work hardest to avoid.
safety.noData: Run the benchmark to see results.
safety.onlyApi: These are the numbers the API returned. Nothing is rounded up.
